Woman Assaulted Outside Kapurthala Temple; Video Sparks FIR

A video showing a woman being beaten with slippers outside the Mata Bhadrakali temple in Kapurthala has gone viral. Following the video's circulation, a First Information Report (FIR) was registered. Police are currently searching for the accused individual. The incident occurred outside the temple premises.
